# OZ Connection
> Arrival support service for backpackers, Working Holiday Visa (WHV) holders and international students settling in Melbourne, Australia.

OZ Connection is a Melbourne-based guidance service helping French and English-speaking backpackers and international students navigate their first weeks in Australia: TFN and ABN applications, bank account setup, SIM card, housing search, CV writing (Australian format), NAATI driving licence translation, and job search direction.

OZ Connection is NOT a registered migration agent (OMARA), NOT a school, NOT a bank, NOT a tax agent. It provides practical orientation and personal guidance only — no immigration advice, no employment guarantee.

## Key pages
- /services — Six à la carte arrival services with prices
- /packages — Three support tiers (Australia Starter $99 AUD, Melbourne Ready $299 AUD, Melbourne Arrival $899 AUD)
- /faq — Answers to common arrival questions
- /about — Founder background and service philosophy
- /pro — Labour matching for Melbourne tradies and builders

## Canonical facts
- Service area: Greater Melbourne, Victoria, Australia (also Australia Starter for clients arriving anywhere in AU)
- Languages: French and English
- Official TFN application: free via the Australian Taxation Office (ato.gov.au)
- Official ABN application: free via the Australian Business Register (abr.gov.au)
- OZ Connection à la carte services (AUD):
  - TFN guidance, ABN guidance, bank account setup, SIM card guidance: see /services for current pricing
  - NAATI driving licence translation: 50 AUD, 24–48 h turnaround
  - CV writing (Australian format): 55 / 85 AUD (standard / premium)
  - Australian postal address: from 7 AUD / month
- Contact: WhatsApp +61 494 652 991 · Email contact@oz-connection.com
- Domain: https://www.oz-connection.com

## What OZ Connection does NOT do
- Visa or migration advice (no OMARA registration)
- Guaranteed employment placement
- Legal, tax or financial advice
- Emergency services (Parents Peace of Mind is reassurance, not emergency response)
